snippet.title: Woozy Official Annoucement Trailer 4k | 1-4 Player Co-op Game
snippet.description:
WISHLIST WOOZY ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4620270/Woozy

YOU HAVE A BILLION-DOLLAR CASINO CHIP.

Here's just one problem.

You and your coworkers need to get it to the Cocktail Casino to cash it in.

Between you and a billion dollars are deserts that cook you, forests that poison you, mountains that freeze you, and an unreasonable number of ways to die.

And if you sober up along the way?

That might kill you too. 🍻

WOOZY is a chaotic 1-4 player online co-op adventure where you and your friends must:

🍺 Scavenge ingredients and brew drinks to survive deadly environments.

🌵 Cross dangerous deserts, poisonous forests, and freezing mountains.

🤝 Rescue your friends from unexpected disasters.

💀 Survive increasingly woozy side effects and somehow make it to the Cocktail Casino.

Grab your friends. Find something to drink. Get the chip to the casino.


WISHLIST NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4620270/Woozy

🎵 MUSIC CREDITS

Track: "Nincompoop" (Instrumental / No Vocals)
Artist and composer: Josh Woodward
Album: Dirty Wings (Instrumentals)

Official song page:
https://www.joshwoodward.com/song/nincompoop
